description: This file contains shell script code that sets up and runs test cases for a 'path-walk' command-line tool, which appears to traverse Git repository objects such as commits, trees, blobs, and tags. It performs various tests to verify the correctness and behavior of the 'path-walk' API under different scenarios, including filtering, boundary conditions, pruning, and object indexing within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, with a descriptive label and the command to run the test.

methods.name: test_cmp_sorted
methods.description: Compares two output files or streams after sorting to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be executed after the test completes.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository setup for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository with specified changes.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Invokes the 'path-walk' command-line tool with specified arguments.
